name: Grupotel Alte Post
beschreibung:
Located in the mountain village of St. Leonhard im Pitztal, this welcoming hotel provides comfortable guestrooms, a serene spa area, and fine half-board dining for outdoor enthusiasts.

The Pitztal Glacier, the Rifflsee ski resort, and scenic waterfall trails are within easy reach.
kurzbeschreibung: Grupotel Alte Post in St. Leonhard im Pitztal offers alpine relaxation and wellness in the majestic Pitztal valley.
